mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW X3 M40i engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW X3 M40i engine replacement typically costs £3,500-£7,500 depending on the condition type and engine code. Used B58 engines start from around £3,500, reconditioned units from £4,000, and rebuilt engines with a 12-month warranty from £4,000. Labour for fitting adds approximately £600-£1,200 for an independent specialist.

mainEntity.name: Is the BMW X3 M40i B58 engine reliable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the B58B30 is widely regarded as one of BMW's best modern engines. With a closed-deck block and forged internals, it delivers exceptional performance and reliability. However, coolant transfer pipe failure is a known weak point, and PCV system issues can occur at higher mileages. Regular maintenance with BMW Longlife-14 approved oil is essential.

mainEntity.name: What causes the BMW X3 M40i coolant leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common cause is the coolant transfer pipe at the front of the B58 engine. The factory plastic pipe becomes brittle under thermal cycling and develops cracks, causing sudden coolant loss. BMW issued a revised pipe to address the issue, but many early M40is are still running the original plastic unit.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW X3 M40i engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical BMW X3 M40i engine replacement takes 3-5 working days for a full rebuild, including parts sourcing, fitting, and testing. Supply-only engines can often be dispatched within 1-3 working days, with fitting then scheduled at your chosen specialist.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the BMW X3 M40i and X3 M?

acceptedAnswer.text: The M40i is powered by the B58B30 straight-six (355-382hp), while the X3 M is powered by the S58B30 twin-turbo straight-six (480-510hp). Both are 3.0-litre petrol engines, but the S58 features a closed-deck block, forged internals, and twin mono-scroll turbos for significantly more power.

mainEntity.name: What engine code is in my BMW X3 M40i?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your BMW X3 M40i will have one of two engine codes depending on its production year: B58B30 (2018-2020, 355hp) or B58B30O1 (2020-2024, 382hp with 48V MHEV). Enter your registration above to confirm the exact code fitted to your vehicle.

Over the G01 production run, the M40i badge carried the B58B30 engine with two distinct power outputs - the earlier 355hp and the later 382hp version with 48V mild hybrid assistance.

commonProblems.h2: BMW X3 M40i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW X3 M40i is powered by the B58B30 straight-six turbo petrol - widely regarded as one of BMW's best modern engines. With a closed-deck block, forged internals, and twin-scroll turbo technology, the B58 delivers effortless power and exceptional refinement. However, coolant transfer pipe failure, PCV system issues, and oil leaks are the most common failure points. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components addressing the original failure point, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Coolant Transfer Pipe Failure - Why the BMW X3 M40i B58 Suffers Sudden Coolant Loss
problems.rootCause: The factory plastic coolant transfer pipe at the front of the B58 engine becomes brittle under repeated thermal cycling, developing cracks that cause sudden and rapid coolant loss. The engine management system reduces power, but continued driving causes overheating and head gasket failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace plastic pipe with updated version, bleed cooling system
repairOptions.longevity: Labour-intensive due to intake removal; permanent fix with revised pipe

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Pipe replacement plus cylinder head gasket, head skim, pressure test
Supply & fit, rebuilt B58 unit with revised cooling components, full warranty

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical 2018-2024 BMW X3 M40i is worth approximately £25,000-£55,000. Replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value, making a rebuilt engine a viable option if needed. For a £30,000+ M40i, a £5,000-£7,500 rebuilt engine is a sensible investment.
problems.recommendation: B58 coolant leaks are the single most discussed issue on X3 M40i forums. If you smell coolant or see the low coolant warning, act immediately. The preventative pipe replacement costs £700-£1,100 at a specialist - a small price on a £25,000+ car. Ignore it, and a £5,000-£7,500 rebuilt engine becomes the only fix. Check your coolant level monthly.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B58B30 BMW X3 M40i engine prices

problems.h4: PCV System Failure - Why the BMW X3 M40i B58 Suffers Oil Consumption and Rough Idle
problems.rootCause: The PCV (Positive Crankcase Ventilation) diaphragm can fail, causing excessive crankcase pressure, oil consumption, and rough idle. In severe cases, it can lead to oil seal failure and increased oil consumption.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace PCV diaphragm, clean throttle body, reset adaptations
repairOptions.longevity: Viable for most failures; restores idle quality

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, rebuilt unit with new PCV system, full warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Only necessary if PCV failure has caused secondary damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW X3 M40i is worth £25,000-£55,000, so a PCV repair is almost always cost-effective. A £300-£500 specialist repair is far cheaper than the £5,000-£7,500 cost of a full engine replacement.
problems.recommendation: PCV failure is common on higher-mileage B58 engines. A £300-£500 repair at a specialist is far cheaper than a full engine rebuild. However, if excessive oil consumption has caused bearing damage, a rebuilt engine may be necessary.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B58B30 BMW X3 M40i engine prices

problems.h4: Oil Leaks - Why the BMW X3 M40i B58 Suffers Gasket Degradation
problems.rootCause: Oil leaks can occur from the oil filter housing gasket, valve cover gasket, and other seals as they degrade over time due to heat cycling.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace failed gasket, clean affected areas, refill oil
Supply & fit, rebuilt unit with all new gaskets and seals, full warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Only necessary if oil loss has caused secondary damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW X3 M40i is worth £25,000-£55,000. Gasket replacement is almost always cost-effective; full engine replacement is rarely justified for oil leaks alone.
problems.recommendation: Oil leaks on the B58 are usually manageable. A £300-£600 gasket replacement at a specialist is far cheaper than a full engine rebuild. However, if oil loss has been severe enough to cause bearing damage (indicated by knocking or low oil pressure), a rebuilt engine may be the only safe path.
